$meta.name: Travel app design tokens - sprint 7 additions
$meta.status: Draft for Raz. DELTA ONLY on top of 0.7.0: every key below is new; no existing value changes; no new colours. Merge into docs/design/tokens.json and apps/mobile/src/theme/tokens.ts in the same PR that first uses them (docs/design/sprint-07/README.md section 15). Keys starting with '$check.' are contrast documentation only and are not merged into tokens.ts.
layover.note: status: invalid (a leg cancelled/diverted) > missed (wait <= 0) > risky (wait < MCT) > short (MCT <= wait < MCT+shortMarginMin) > ok. No MCT in an old device copy: no tag. The client never defines a default MCT; the server's 60 is the only default (README 3.2). Wait shown as 'N min' under minutesUntil, 'H:mm' from it (README 3.3).
size.layover.note: Rail: dashed, border.control, on the start side (borderStart, flips in RTL), spanning the row between the two leg cards. Row has no card background; it sits on openRow (README 3.1).
motion.layover.note: change: tag cross-fade, notices in/out (out uses accelerate). relayout: legs regrouping when a save creates/breaks a route, then the sprint 2 flash. Reduce motion: immediate. Split-flap on the wait digits is a proposal (README 12).
color.layover.map: No new colours. ok = successSubtleBg/Fg (as 'on time'); short = infoBg/Fg (as 'departed'); risky = entryRestrictedBg/Fg (as 'delayed'); missed/invalid text = text.alert 500; invalid icon = NoEntryIcon in text.alert; transit = EntryTag of sprint 4 unchanged (README 3.4, 5.2).
$check.contrast.method: WCAG 2.x relative luminance, (L1+0.05)/(L2+0.05), on the hex values in tokens.ts. Text 4.5:1, graphics 3:1 (1.4.11). openRow = light #FBF4E8, dark #1A2749.
$check.contrast.darkPillNote: In dark mode infoBg and entryRestrictedBg equal openRow (#1A2749): the pill shape disappears, the word and icon carry the meaning (text 9.33 / 7.13). Optional fallback without a new colour: 1dp border.control outline on those tags in dark mode only (README 15.1).
